swarm_technique: #47 Sound-to-Action: every gesture keyed to a speech or sound event; holds and silences are scored

caption_style.font: Liberation Serif Italic (system) or equivalent serif italic
caption_style.position: bottom of 720x540 picture area, baseline 36 px above picture bottom
caption_style.label_S2: « — selon lui — » top centre of picture, same face 18 px, 80 % opacity, every S2 frame 216-467

captions.fr: « Votre boîte… je l'ai rapportée chez votre tante le 14 mars, »
captions.en: Your box... I brought it back to your aunt's on the 14th of March,
She opened it in front of me.

captions.note: over the shadow play; « — selon lui — » label stays on top of picture

captions.fr: « Je l'ai refermée, je la lui ai donnée. »
captions.en: I closed it, I gave it to her.
captions.note: caption follows the swallow (frames 406-413): the lid is shut while hidden, the words name it afterwards
split point « Rien n'y » / « manquait. »; the second half is appended on the same line (no re-layout) at 586 = CUE-3 onset; 567/586 are the approved test-shot frames (23.625 s / 24.417 s)

viseme_track.reason: voice is captions only (no TTS, no foraged speech); the photo-cutout mouths are not animated, so there is no mouth flapping in silence. Speaking is carried by caption timing and his lean (CUE-1, CUE-3pre); her silence is scored as holds.

master.action: box HELD in both hands at lap height (fingers occlude box edges), head 0 deg
master.notes: expressive hold: she listens; no motion without a reason

master.action: lean in, torso/head 0 -> +3 deg (toward her), drawings on twos
head HOLDS at 0 deg (no reaction to C1: P4 / no early suspicion)
sets the box down on her lap: hands lower 0 -> 1 (box drops ~38 px at 720x540), contact, 2 px settle bounce, fingers stay on box sides
master.ease: ease-in (accelerate) then contact at 144, 1-frame squash, settle by 150
master.hold: hold box on lap (fingers on its sides) to end
master.sound: soft lap set-down at frame 144 (fabric-muffled wood/metal tick)
master.notes: she accepts the object: E1 materially corroborates C1 in front of the viewer

master.clause: CAP-C2a « Elle l'a ouverte devant moi »
master.action: thumbs press the clasp; lid lifts 0 -> 10 % (one drawing), held at the cut
master.hold: lid at 10 % to the cut at 216
master.notes: she checks the thing he names, with her hands, not her head (head still under C2); master only. Baseline: thumbs rest, lid stays closed

master.action: hard cut to shadow theatre; warm paper +5 %, « — selon lui — », muffled reverberant bed
door opens (3 drawings), R. enters, 8-pose walk on twos, far arm bent behind back
offers box with near hand (6 drawings); far hand inside torso silhouette
master.sound: box tick into the aunt's hands at 341 (muffled)

master.action: aunt opens lid (4 drawings started at 348, before the line: the image shows what the line will name); ring as punched light ring; earring swings
master.notes: teller-side action: the image may precede the clause because it is his illustration, not a listener reaction (P4 applies to listener actions only)

master.action: closes lid with near hand while body turns ~10 deg; box behind torso 406-413 (8 frames); elbow +6 deg; box re-emerges closed; handed to aunt, set on her lap
master.sound: lid shut, muffled, at 408 (inside the swallow; heard, not seen); set-down tick 456; NO ring sound (declared silence)

master.action: hard cut to present insert: open box on her lap, ring slot EMPTY at the same normalised position as the ring in S2c; tint neutral; dry sound
master.hold: insert 468-515 (slight motion: 1.5 % slow push-in + her breathing lift 1 px)
master.sound: room tone + clock return dry on frame 468

master.action: cut to two-shot, box open on her lap
lean in starts, planned 0 -> +4 deg by 605
master.notes: he leans in to close the case

master.action: head (with hat brim) drops -11 deg toward the box
master.hold: hold -11 deg to S4 turn at 734
master.notes: first moving frame of her head == onset of « manquait » (acceptance 4: +-2 frames)

master.action: lean STOPS where it is (~+2.6 deg); he holds still: he notices
master.notes: last moving frame <= 592 (within 6 frames of the drop)

master.action: far (right) hand comes forward from behind his thigh onto his knee: the hand the shadow hid
master.notes: answers the swallow: the gesture the telling concealed is now shown in the room

master.clause: (object event) slip falls from his breast pocket
master.action: folded slip slides out (accelerate), falls to the sofa cushion between them, one small bounce, settles
master.ease: gravity: accelerate 706-718, contact 718, bounce 6 px 718-722, settle 725

master.action: head turns from the box toward the slip (-11 -> -6 deg, 4 deg toward him)
master.notes: impact cue -> reaction spaced 16 frames (#47: impact and reaction appropriately spaced)

master.action: unfolds the receipt (3 drawings: 756, 770, 784); slow hold on the date line « Engagé le 14 mars 1953 »
lays the receipt in the empty slot
closes the lid (2 drawings), click on contact
turns her head away from him +8 deg (toward frame edge) and holds
does not move (declared hold)
room tone fades 1008-1032; black 1032-1055; silence

baseline.definition: same script, --baseline: identical timing; (1) S3a insert 468-515 replaced by the two-shot held with the lid CLOSED (CUE-2a lid lift omitted: thumbs rest on the lid); (2) her head 0 deg throughout (CUE-3, CUE-4L, CUE-5c removed); his lean CUE-3pre runs to +4 and holds (no stop, nothing to notice), CUE-3h kept; (3) S4/S5 (receipt fall, insert, receipt into slot, lid close, turn) removed: two-shot held 696-1008, then fade
baseline.sound: identical beds; receipt, lid and slot sounds (718-948) removed; clock continues
baseline.expected_reading: C1 and E2 consistent; nothing contests him

silences.what: no caption, no voice; clock only + his hand rustle at 648: the look is the event
no caption; lid click then clock; her turn away is the answer
no ring sound during the swallow (declared silence; the lid shut is heard at 408)

assertions.rule: P4: for every listener action, action_onset_frame >= onset_frame of its clause, in every cut
